def VTask.replaceVertex {V : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V) [DecidableEq V] : SimpleGraph V :=
  { adj := fun v w => if v = t then (G.Adj s w ∧ w ≠ t) ∨ G.Adj v w
                       else if w = t then (G.Adj s v ∧ v ≠ t) ∨ G.Adj v w
                       else G.Adj v w,
    loopless := by
      intro v
      by_cases h : v = t
      · -- Case v = t
        simp [h]
        <;>
        (try simp_all [SimpleGraph.loopless, Ne]) <;>
        (try tauto) <;>
        (try {
          have h₁ := G.loopless s
          have h₂ := G.loopless t
          simp_all [Ne]
          <;> tauto
        })
      · -- Case v ≠ t
        by_cases h' : v = s
        · -- Subcase v = s
          simp [h, h']
          <;>
          (try simp_all [SimpleGraph.loopless, Ne]) <;>
          (try tauto) <;>
          (try {
            have h₁ := G.loopless s
            have h₂ := G.loopless t
            simp_all [Ne]
            <;> tauto
          })
        · -- Subcase v ≠ s and v ≠ t
          simp [h]
          <;>
          (try simp_all [SimpleGraph.loopless, Ne]) <;>
          (try tauto) <;>
          (try {
            have h₁ := G.loopless v
            simp_all [Ne]
            <;> tauto
          })
  }
